protocol.timing: Python single-request adapter boundary, including binding and result assembly; not HTTP or pure-kernel latency
protocol.selection: Minimum qualified pooled P50 at a common recall threshold; P95/P99 from the same measured setting; no interpolation
protocol.aggregation: Geometric mean of baseline / Orion latency over listed common datasets; above 1 favors Orion
protocol.control: Separate run, one effort per dataset, serial SIMD kernel; native no-GIL is not a complete recall curve
protocol.limitations: Different processes and times; descriptive results, not significance-tested. Actual recall and coverage vary.
